## Author checklist

- [ ] The pull request addresses one primary Issue and satisfies its acceptance criteria.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff, including generated or configuration changes.
- [ ] Architecture boundaries and strict type requirements are satisfied.
- [ ] New normalized fields retain source, unit, time, status, and transformation provenance.
- [ ] Missing values remain distinct from zero, empty, and not applicable.
- [ ] Required unit, contract, integration, end-to-end, and regression tests are present.
- [ ] Public behaviour and contributor documentation are updated where required.
- [ ] No credentials, signed URLs, personal data, restricted bulk data, or unsafe fixtures are included.
- [ ] New suppressions or exclusions are narrow and justified.
- [ ] Configuration, migration, health, recovery, and compatibility impact is addressed where applicable.
- [ ] Known limitations and unfinished work are linked to follow-up Issues.
- [ ] The change satisfies the repository Definition of Done.
